2ea92c48.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"On the Shal'nan"
2ea92c48.title: On the Shal'nan

5c608413.text: "Many were dismayed by his abdication, but many also applauded his willingness to cede power so readily after more than a century of near-total authority. In the thousands of years of elvish history, few rulers have ever shown such magnanimity, and it is this act of selflessness that will seal him in our memory forever."
5c608413.title: On the Shal'nan

7f86a0f7.text:
"A shen'dorei of intense presence, the Shal'nan was a great orator who could stir the hearts of his people and inspire respect even among his enemies. His rousing words were the lynchpin that galvanized our people in rebellion against the hated Prince Tortheldrin. 

It was his determination and unwavering resolve that saved us in the aftermath of our failed rebellion. The Shal'nan ensured our survival during our flight across the sea. It was also the Shal'nan himself who brokered our peace with the wind spirits and allowed us to ascend to the elemental plane."
7f86a0f7.title: On the Shal'nan

b91a986d.text:
"However, something changed after that final, fateful battle in Eldre'Thalas. It is widely known that the Shal'nan was ever a reluctant leader in the years following our flight from our ancient home. Gone were the days of fiery speeches and rallying commands; they were replaced with quiet, contemplative leadership.

The Shal'nan listened more than he spoke, and when he did speak, he chose his words carefully. He seemed hesitant, and at times, distant."
b91a986d.title: On the Shal'nan

c051be56.text:
"Many assumed this change in the Shal'nan was the result of a great injury or trauma sustained in his final battle with Tortheldrin's forces. Others believed that, in this time of relative peace, he simply had no need for his fiery wartime persona.

Despite this change, the Shal'nan led our people with quiet determination in those early years. He never wavered in his resolve, even in the face of overwhelming challenges. Our Shal'nan was, by all accounts of the time, a superb leader despite his change in demeanor, right up until his abdication to the provincial council after the founding of the $R Isles within Skywall."
c051be56.title: On the Shal'nan

92472-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92472-accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472-accept.title: The Next Step

92484-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92484-accept.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $C trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
92484-accept.title: Embracing the Elements
